architecture_upgrade: CCCXLIX derived sector maps from W33 operator provenance. CCCL uses those maps as actual GLS/BIC model hypotheses and verifies that generated sector structure is selected over one-sector and free-channel alternatives.
theorem: W33-derived sector maps can be treated as statistical model hypotheses. If response scales are generated by one of the provenance-derived maps, GLS/BIC recovers that map; if the packet is unstructured, the free-channel alternative is selected instead.
honesty_boundary: The packets here are synthetic. Real use requires measured response scales or response scales derived from deeper W33 operator data.
